correctness.rationale: The retained class-count proof is correct. A transitive signed K-action is determined up to monomial equivalence by a line stabilizer H and its sign character, with no further conjugacy identification when K is abelian. This gives four size-one types, six size-two types, and one size-four type. Passing from embeddings to images requires precomposition by Aut(K)=S₃ in addition to target conjugation. I verified that a transposition fixes two size-one types and swaps the others, and fixes two size-two types with two swaps; a three-cycle fixes the trivial size-one type and has one size-one triple and two size-two triples. Every nontrivial automorphism fixes the unique size-four type. In a fixed profile the multiplicities must agree around each type cycle, yielding the repaired P,T,C factors. The noninjective orbits are exactly the target classes of elements of order dividing two, giving the two size-one factors and one size-two factor of I. The order-eleven pole of P at 1 has principal coefficient 1/(2⁶·4)=1/256; other poles have smaller order, and the proper rational series has poles only at twelfth roots of unity. Partial fractions prove the exact quasipolynomial claim and leading coefficient. The removed labeled EGF was mathematically correct; the issue was prior implication, not a false formula. I reran the rewritten class-only checker and confirmed all coefficients through rank ten and the actual conjugacy classes through rank five.
residual_risks: The direct census is exhaustive only through rank five. The all-rank statement uses the independently checked signed-action proof and proper rational partial fractions.

evidence: After q=2z, Tamanoi’s exponential formula for source C₂² contributes 4z, 6z² and 2z⁴ from subgroup indices 1, 2 and 4. The source-C₂ and trivial EGFs are exp(2z+z²) and exp(z). originality.rationale: The original two-enumerator claim fails originality in part: Tamanoi’s Theorem C (1-16) already implies exactly the labeled-subgroup EGF by parameter specialization and standard kernel-lattice subtraction. The corrected result removes that formula as a contribution and attributes the known signed-profile framework. What survives is the ordinary class series: the product for target conjugation alone is already known, but it gives only P. The repair explicitly accounts for source-generator changes by the cycle types of Aut(K) and for faithfulness, giving T, C and I. Neither the theorem inspected nor a distinct exact indexed or published result inspected gave that subgroup-class calculation. The pass is for the narrower finding, not the original combined claim.
residual_risks: A source-automorphism-twisted general wreath-product enumeration or otherwise equivalent subgroup-class census could exist outside the inspected material. Müller's full text was not inspectable, so no claim about its coverage beyond bibliographic identification is made.
No priority inference is made from the relative order of same-date catalogue results.

value.rationale: The retained invariant is a natural all-rank conjugacy census in the signed permutation Weyl groups. It supplies class counts independent of chosen generators and avoids enumerating the factorial-sized target group, with an exact series and growth law. The three source cycle types and the faithfulness subtraction distinguish this from an already-known count of labeled embeddings or target-conjugacy classes of homomorphisms. The repair does not rely on the covered EGF or extra motivation to supply value.
residual_risks: The value is the exact rank-two class census, not a claim of novel general enumeration machinery or a solution for all elementary abelian ranks.
